summary.text: Aaron Bernstine is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 8, which he has represented since December 2022, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
His career includes work as a farmer and business owner, adjunct professor, sales manager and director of business development.

paragraphs.text: Bernstine graduated from Union Area High School in 2003, earned a B.S. in business management from Pennsylvania State University in 2006, and received an M.B.A. in finance and international business from the University of Pittsburgh in 2013.
In the 2023-2024 session Bernstine was assigned to the House Finance Committee and the Gaming Oversight Committee.
